deadline.value: No strict deadline; the committee considers applications as received, with Fall applications considered by mid-March.
deadline.quote: We do not have a strict deadline, and applications are reviewed as soon as they're received by the admission committee.

also.quote: considers applications by mid-September for the following Spring admission and by mid-March for the following Fall admission

gre_general.value: GRE required for applicants with a non-U.S. degree, which covers Indian applicants; the department calls the score requirement soft.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is required for students who obtained their degree from schools outside the United States.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

toefl_min.value: Department minimum TOEFL iBT 81 for non-U.S. degree holders, above the graduate school minimum.
toefl_min.quote: you must have a minimum TOEFL ibT score of 81 (IELTS of 7; PTE Academic equivalent of 54)

ielts_min.value: Department minimum IELTS 7 overall for non-U.S. degree holders.
ielts_min.quote: you must have a minimum TOEFL ibT score of 81 (IELTS of 7; PTE Academic equivalent of 54)

supervisor.value: Admission is by the department committee; a first-semester rotation lets students choose a supervisor.
supervisor.quote: You do NOT need to directly contact faculty members to choose your research group and the supervisor.

funding.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed to apply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: You do not need to have M.S. degree to apply to our Ph.D. program.

notes: Graduate School table lists Fall April 15; the department page says mid-March and no strict deadline, so the program uses the department rule. Biochemistry also offers a PhD in this department (not saved).
name: Chemistry and Biochemistry PhD
